name: Nakano Misaki
source:
A cheerful, easy-going, and caring mother. When she divorced her husband, she wanted to take her son with her. But considering the education and finance, she gave the custody of her son to her husband. Because of this, she always meets with her son every month. Ever since she broke up with her husband, she has been single.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1241040]Getchu[/url]]
